sessions.final_text:
`balances` and `settle` now print amounts with thousands separators, so `-121810.78` shows as `-121,810.78`. The unit tests pass, and `checks/thousands.sh` prints `ok`.

I added a `grouping` option to `format_cents` in `tally/money.py` and turned it on in `tally/report.py`. Its default is off, so `export` still writes plain amounts to CSV. I also added a unit test for the grouped format in `tests/test_money.py`.

I didn't run `settle` on `examples/big.csv` or add a test for it. It goes through the same `format_cents(..., grouping=True)` call as `balances`.

I didn't touch `README.md`, since it doesn't show any amounts.

    whole, frac = divmod(abs(cents), 100)

    """Formats cents as a decimal string: 1250 -> "12.50", -5 -> "-0.05".

    sign = "-" if cents < 0 else ""
    whole, frac = divmod(abs(cents), 100)
    whole_text = f"{whole:,}" if grouping else str(whole)
